title: The IFCASL Corpus of French and German Non-native and Native Read Speech
why_promising: Primary French/German native and non-native read speech from about 100 speakers; corpus documentation reports word- and phone-level segmentation with more than 50% manually corrected data, and project documentation states the French and German native/non-native data were manually checked and annotated after automatic alignment.
open_question: Locate a currently public observation-level corpus deposit; enumerate annotation/audio files; determine whether manually checked/corrected files can be isolated from any remaining automatic-only alignments and establish redistribution/license provenance before core admission.
